newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-VICENZA BEAT BOLOGNA 1-0 IN ITALIAN CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VICENZA BEAT BOLOGNA 1-0 IN ITALIAN CUP.

text.p: Vicenza, in a battle between the two surprise sides of the Serie A season, hung on to beat Bologna 1-0 in the first leg of their Italian Cup semifinal on Thursday.
Striker Roberto Murgita headed in the lone goal from a free kick by midfielder Massimo Beghetto seconds before the interval.

Bologna had the best chances prior to that, with striker Carlo Nervo hitting the post in the eighth minute and Russian international Igor Kolyvanov forcing an acrobatic save from goalkeeper Francesco Antonioli in the 36th.

Neither side had the upper hand in the second half, although Bologna coach Renzo Ulivieri was visibly upset when the referee failed to award a penalty kick in the 85th minute after the ball hit Murgita's hand in the area.
The referee gestured that contact had been accidental.
The second leg will be played on February 27 with the ultimate winner facing either Internazionale or Napoli, who drew 1-1 in their first leg in Milan last week.
Vicenza and Bologna, whose first leg match was rescheduled after fog forced its cancellation last week, are separated by just a point in the league table.
Bologna are alone in third place on 31 points, five behind leaders Juventus.
The winner of the Italian Cup gains a place in next year's European Cup Winners' Cup -- an almost unthinkable dream for two teams who started the season with avoiding relegation their main goal.
